content.text: For digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-everything-you|COREMERCH guide to creators]] in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines, the dream of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-selling-digital-downloads-pakistan-works-how-deploy-2|How Selling]]-ebooks-nigeria-without-paypal-honest-side-side-2|selling]] digital products online is often thwarted by Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle restrictions. Yet, what if you could build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, without relying on any platform? Welcome to COREMERCH, where sovereign infrastructure meets digital commerce.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem with relying on platforms like Stripe and PayPal is that they can shut down your account at any time, leaving you without a way to collect payments from your customers. But with COREMERCH, you own everything after deployment, including your payment and delivery pipeline. This means you have complete control over your digital store and can make changes as needed without relying on a third-party platform. By deploying your store on Cloudflare Pages and using Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, you can create a seamless payment and delivery experience that works even when platforms fail.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your digital store, you'll need a few key components in place. First, you'll need to create a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site to host your store. Next, you'll need to set up a payment and delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Workers and Supabase. Finally, you'll need to configure your payment layer using NOWPayments. With these components in place, you'll be ready to deploy your store and start selling digital products to your customers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in deploying your digital store. With Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, you can create a custom payment and delivery experience that works seamlessly with your store. By integrating NOWPayments, you can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies and process payments in real-time. With this setup, you'll be able to deliver your digital products to your customers quickly and efficiently, without relying on a third-party platform.
You own everything after deployment, including your payment and delivery pipeline.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live with your digital store. With Cloudflare Pages, you can deploy your store quickly and easily, without relying on a third-party platform. By configuring your payment layer and testing your store on mainnet, you'll be able to process your first transaction and start selling digital products to your customers. With COREMERCH, you'll have complete control over your digital store and can make changes as needed to optimize your sales and revenue.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is up and running, it's time to think about scaling. With COREMERCH, you can easily scale your store to meet the demands of your growing customer base. By using Cloudflare Pages and Cloudflare Workers, you can create a highly scalable and performant store that can handle large volumes of traffic and sales. With this setup, you'll be able to process payments quickly and efficiently, without experiencing any downtime or disruptions.
